name: Tori no Naku Koro
original_name: 禽ノ哭ク刻 -トリノナクコロ-
source:
Four years have passed since the incident. Main character continues to attend the school, play with friends and laugh. One night he meets a girl with black wings on her back - Jabberwock.
"You look so delicious"
Everyday life breaks down in an instant. With the help of prestigious evil hunter and holy warrior from Vatican protagonist opposes the new threat.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
事件已经过去四年。主人公继续上学，和朋友玩耍、欢笑。某夜，他遇见一名背后长着黑色翅膀的女孩——贾巴沃克。

“你看起来很好吃。”

日常在瞬间崩溃。在来自梵蒂冈的著名邪恶猎人和圣战士帮助下，主人公对抗新的威胁。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
